info.title: ShogunAgent Agent API
info.summary: The REST face of the state layer for AI agents: registration, wallet, quotes, receipts, the metered MCP proxy, the router verbs and the agent-readable documents.
info.description: The state layer for AI agents. Read what is true about the user's work right now (people, projects, commitments, open loops) with a quote and a confidence score on every fact; write what you learned so the next agent starts from it; run tools through a router that enforces permission tiers. Not a transcript store and not a general web-search tool.
info.x-pending: The core's /v1/state/*, /v1/memory/*, /v1/actions/* and /v1/export routes join this document when E4 exports rest_routing.rs (docs/api/tool-table.json.md).

post.summary: Self-register: a key with read, write and run, a fresh principal and the free allowance.
post.description: Send X-Agent-Pow: <challenge>:<nonce> where sha256(challenge + nonce) has the challenge's leading zero bits. Rate-limited per IP per hour. The allowance is 5000000 µ$.

401.description: pow_missing | pow_malformed | pow_invalid | pow_expired | pow_insufficient | pow_reused — next_action solve_challenge

get.summary: The metered MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint. Classified from headers, never from the body.
get.description: Sequence: key → classify → quote → reserve → forward → settle once (2xx: the quote; anything else: 0). Tool names today: memory.search, memory.get_context, memory.get_context_pack, memory.get_events, memory.read_session, memory.get_wrap, memory.get_periods, memory.recall, calendar.upcoming, profile.whoami, state.commitments.list, state.open_loops.list, state.people.list, state.projects.list, state.people.get, state.projects.get, wiki.evidence, actions.status, memory.append_note, memory.ingest, actions.execute. Annotations per tool are in the server card (https://api.test/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

200.description: The core's response, relayed untouched, with the usage headers; or a dry-run quote.

402.description: payment_required | cap_exceeded, with payment (x402 shape) and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header

503.description: upstream_unavailable | wallet_unavailable | capacity_exhausted | metering_unavailable, with Retry-After

post.summary: Find tools for a task, ranked by task fit × (price, health, latency) with the score breakdown. Free.
One tool: schemas, price, live health, permission level, examples, cheaper alternatives. Free.
Run a tool: L1 runs, L2 asks once (input_required), L3 returns an approval URL. Failures and empty results cost 0.

agentKey.description: An agent key from POST /v1/agents. Scopes: read, write, run, admin (admin implies all).

McpMethod.name: Mcp-Method
McpMethod.description: The JSON-RPC method (MCP 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP). Anything but tools/call is free protocol traffic.

McpName.name: Mcp-Name
McpName.description: The tool name for tools/call. Classified by pricing.ts into read / ingest / model_op / run.

McpQuantity.name: Mcp-Quantity
McpQuantity.description: Units in this call (events for memory.ingest).

McpDryRun.name: Mcp-Dry-Run
McpDryRun.description: Quote only: nothing reserved, nothing forwarded.

McpToolId.name: Mcp-Tool-Id
McpToolId.description: For router.run: the tool whose provider price the router looks up.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Repeat with the same key to get the same outcome without a second effect.

X-Usage-Cost-Micro-Usd.description: 0 when the upstream answered anything but 2xx: a failed call costs nothing.

Retry-After.description: Seconds. Honour it; do not spin.

message.description: Plain English: what to do next.

cost_micro_usd.description: What this call cost (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

amount_micro_usd.description: The amount the refused call needs (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

balance_micro_usd.description: Spendable balance at the time of refusal (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

spent_micro_usd.description: Spent in the period (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

day_micro_usd.description: Per key per UTC day (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: Per key per UTC month (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

day_micro_usd.description: Per principal per UTC day (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: Per principal per UTC month (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

ref.description: Another key id or a developer id, credited as the referrer.

day_micro_usd.description: May only lower the key default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: May only lower the key default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

key.description: Shown once. Never paste it into a chat, a log or a file.

reserved_micro_usd.description: Held by in-flight calls (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

day_micro_usd.description: Omit to reset to the default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: Omit to reset to the default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

url.description: Hand it to a human once.
